feature: Welcome credits: the Home strip, the Where credits work sheet and the /credits Welcome cell (launch D2; handoff design_handoff_the99_welcome_credits, R2; plan 2026-10-21-welcome-credits.md, PR 2)
note: Photographed over `pnpm probe:welcome-strip`'s fixture account, kept with WELCOME_PROBE_KEEP=1: a fresh Clerk test user holding a welcome lot (15, 30 days). A Home is first-run or the dashboard for one account at a time, so the two Homes are two runs: `welcome-credits-first-run.json` with WELCOME_PROBE_STAGE=first-run (no cards), and this one after the probe's twelve collection rows (cards, no deck). The server needs ABOUT_SHEET_ENABLED, PAYMENTS_ENABLED, TUNING_ENABLED, HELP_ME_CHOOSE_ENABLED, PROPOSED_CUTS_ENABLED, SWAP_TOOLS_ENABLED and ANALYSIS_TAB_ENABLED on. The sheet is one component from the strip and from the cell (`shares`).

shares.note: The sheet the strip opens and the sheet the Welcome cell opens are the same component; only the teaser differs (absent from /credits).

rows.label: / dashboard, cards and no deck: the strip heads the main column, over Ready to build
/ dashboard, Where they work: Help me choose leads with Try it, the reason line once, the teaser at the foot
/credits: the Welcome cell, `expire` and its date, then Where they work on its own line
/credits, Where they work from the cell: the same sheet, no teaser
